name: 04-echo-nested-path
description: The wildcard listener echoes a nested path in full.

source.reference: http-request-response-with-logger/src/main/app/echo.xml (flow EchoFlow: http:listener path='/*'; set-payload value='#[message.inboundProperties['http.request.path']]'); http.request.path is the full path matched by listener path='/*'
